text:
Mae: small idea—who's up for a reusable-mug pledge + scone swap tomorrow morning? ☕🥐
Anil: love this. count me in for a cinnamon raisin scone.
Jordan: I can bring almond milk and maybe lemon poppyseed scones. who wants to volunteer to remind folks about mugs (i keep forgetting) :sweat_smile:
Mae: @Jordan thanks! I'll make a tiny poster by the sink. 
Priya: can we make it coffee-first? i have a new french press worth trying.
Mae: yes! plan: 9:30 AM, kitchen table. bring scone or mug or both.
Jordan: also proposal: small sticker on the cabinet—"mug pledge: refill, don’t use disposables" —i'll print 20.
Anil: +1 on sticker. also can we add a note for nut-free items? someone brought almond in last time and a bit of panic.
Priya: good call. label with allergens.
CoffeeBot: AUTOMATED MESSAGE: Oat milk restocked (2 cartons), whole milk low (1 carton). K-Cup stash at 67%.
Mae: thanks @CoffeeBot — i'll pick up 1 more whole milk on my walk unless someone else wants to grab it.
Jordan: i can grab milk and paper cups? (for backup only)
Anil: please no disposables if possible — bring cups only if you agree to take them back home.
Priya: i'll bring a small allergy label sheet and some masking tape to stick it on scone boxes.
Mae: simple checklist for tomorrow: 1) mugs + pledge sticker, 2) scone swap table + labels, 3) french press demo 9:25, 4) milk refill if needed.
Anil: love it. count me for setup at 9:15.
Jordan: tagged the calendar invite — "Mug pledge & scone swap" so people know. not a meeting, just low-pressure snacking.
Mae: perfect. if anyone has an egg-free scone recipe pls DM me and i'll print it.
Priya: i'll post the allergy label template in #lunch-plans pinned docs after this.
Jordan: :thumbsup: see y'all tomorrow.
Mae: thanks everyone — and remember, mugs = karma points :sparkles:
